content: What do you want from me? Speak clearly.
I need to know why you're pushing me to turn over that information. Maybe we can find a way to settle this without any trouble.
Settle? You're running out of time. If you don't deliver what I asked, things won't just get difficult, they'll become dangerous. You know what I'm capable of.
Look, I'm trying to cooperate, but I need a little more time. I'm not trying to be difficult here.
Time isn't something I'm willing to give you. Miss one deadline and I promise you, the consequences won't be limited to words. I won't hesitate to make an example out of you.
Please, just tell me what you want exactly. I don't want this to get worse.
You know what I want. And if you think I'm bluffing, remember the last person who tried to stall. They're not around to answer questions anymore.
Alright, I'm getting it done. Just give me a little time and no one else has to get hurt.
Make sure you follow through. Fail me, and I won't just come after you, I'll make sure everyone close to you feels the fallout.
